new_arguments.cursor: opaque actual Fabric next_cursor; never invented or generated by model
new_arguments.previous_action_id: host receipt action_id, never sent as upstream filter
new_arguments.page_number: integer 2..5, actual previous page_number + 1; cap includes first page
new_arguments.max_seq: actual Fabric coverage.max_seq echoed from preceding page

pagination.next_cursor: nonempty string iff has_more, otherwise null
pagination.max_seq: nonnegative integer from actual response coverage.max_seq

rules: Initial catalog remains once per source/scope, only actual-empty initial alternatives and no evidence; ordinary empty search stays invalid.
A catalog continuation may have existing evidence; it needs a completed prior search receipt and actual next_cursor.
Cursor HMAC/permissions/max_seq enforcement remains host and Fabric responsibility. Planner never executes or makes keys.
Unknown/prepared/sent/unconfirmed precede every new action or completion; changed action ID/index/reason cannot repeat an attempted cursor.
No changed query, limit, scope or snapshot may reuse a prior cursor. No new cursor after failed/unknown response without reconciliation.
Legacy baseline/v1 remain byte-identical. No scenario names, expected facts or evaluator-selected source IDs are used.
Legal affordable continuations are selected before new queries and other actions; this is a visible retrieval obligation, not measured gain.
action_limits.document_search counts first-page attempts only. Failed/not_sent attempts count. All pages consume actual tool_calls and max_steps; every chain has at most five total pages.
incomplete_search_chains records unfinished chains and candidate_ids/unavailable_reason, never an estimate of unseen pages/documents. Capped chains remain incomplete.

Missing continuation candidates return reason=continuation_candidate_required, action=null, state_summary.execution_state=awaiting_host_candidates and terminal=false. Host reconstructs an authorized candidate from its actual saved receipt and calls decide again; this is not a terminal stop.
Unavailable source/permission/cost must be expressed by candidate applicability/estimated_cost or current budget. No candidate or cursor is invented by planner.

named_objects bind exact question spans and adopted read evidence IDs. Host verifies occurrence in read text. Missing object lookups are prioritized after continuations; every unmet object keeps candidate IDs and an unavailable reason on stop.
host_requirements: First-page actions that expose pagination receipts must also retain explicit provider/source_id/terms/limit/mode/as_of/is_demo/scope.
Preserve full pagination in saved AnalysisQueryReceipt and policy_request.history; independent importer compares them.

Testing supplies action_limits.document_search=16 and document_read=32. Keep actual all-page tool budgets separate from the new-query allowance. Existing method version records the change; no new profile switch.
Handle awaiting_host_candidates by rebuilding from the saved receipt and calling decide again. Do not interpret every insufficient enum as a terminal stop.

host_budget_allocation.all_tools: Every page consumes actual unified tool_calls and max_steps. New-query allowance is not the actual tool budget.
host_budget_allocation.explicit_initial_queries: All declared first-page attempts consume new-query allowance.
host_budget_allocation.baseline: Original external.v1 prompt/order/action space and native baseline are unchanged; old frozen executables/results remain retained.
host_budget_allocation.comparison_qualification: Changed v2 capability/selection rule, heuristic_untrained; not a pure learned-policy causal advantage.

fabric_wire.catalog_terms: omit terms parameters; do not send a fake empty string
fabric_wire.authentication_boundary: Fabric validates HMAC/permission at every page; host only adopts cursors it actually received. This does not claim protection against a READ_TOKEN holder re-signing a cursor.

fields.name: exact question substring
fields.evidence_ids: adopted read evidence IDs, actual name occurrence verified by host

named_objects.output: state_summary.unmet_named_objects lists every unresolved object with available_candidate_ids and unavailable_reason; nonempty blocks complete.

output_additions.terminal: false for selected action, reconciliation or awaiting_host_candidates; true for actual stop
